decision_notes: The state Constitution ArticleVI vests legislative power in the Senate and House of Delegates. This is the state legislature, not a city/county council; institutional Wikidata Q7986861 corroborates identity.

Official provenance and proceedings: The maintained official media hub directly designates House/Senate provider channels, Senate committee-room links and archived audio. Two historical House recordings (school-safety session and SB275 virtual public hearing) show actual proceedings with advancing decoded video. Their provider dates are retained separately; this does not certify current live or Senate/committee-room playback. The page reports no meetings scheduled on 23 October 2026; its live embeds did not start on this attempt. School-safety provider publication: 14 June 2022. SB275 hearing description dates the event 4 March 2021, while provider publication is 5 March 2021; these dates are not conflated.

Source conditions: The linked Terms of Use provides public-information, accuracy and external-link disclaimers, not a blanket audiovisual reuse licence. No independent playback/redistribution permission was established. Keep official link-out.
Added as official link-out; regional flag, parent-country search, map and planned event/recording-index links reconciled.
